speaker: Doctor

speaker: Doctor
text: Since your bronchoscopy and previous imaging are normal, I need to investigate if your condition is related to an immune deficiency or a specific genetic defect like Primary Ciliary Dyskinesia. speaker: Doctor
text: With structural, genetic, and immune workups returning normal, could you clarify if you ever notice the cough worsening after eating or if you experience frequent heartburn and acid regurgitation? DIAGNOSIS READY: Primary Ciliary Dyskinesia (Kartagener Syndrome variant without situs inversus)

*Note: While the patient denied sinus/ear issues in previous responses, the classic triad of chronic productive cough, recurrent bronchitis, and non-smoker status with normal structural/genetic/immune workups strongly points to PCD, which may present with subtle or underreported sinus history. The "thick, foamy" sputum is consistent with impaired mucociliary clearance.*
